page.layout: One printed page: title page, all lines centred in one column, with a woodcut of a tree and a hare-like animal between the title and the imprint. No margin notes. Handwritten "a" at top right is not printed.
page.notes: Woodcut of a tree with a small animal at its base, between the title and the imprint; not text. Handwritten "a" and an underline at top right are not printed. Lines with hyphens at the line end ("AD MALEDI-", "LI-", "mi-", "Domi-") are printed hyphens; the words are split across lines as printed. The long s is written as plain s throughout.
